why: One of the two topics whose population column is the general population rather than the rate's own denominator (#5067). Preventable hospitalizations are measured among Medicare enrollees ages 18+, but no Medicare population is available broken down by race, so the table substitutes the adult population and labels the substitution. There is also no pct_share metric on this topic, so the caseload share column is genuinely absent. Both facts have to reach the prompt: the column list may name only the rate and the population share, and the caveat must say the population counts a broader group, or the model will present a rough comparison as an exact one.
